title: Reconstruction Billing Worksheet: Final Draw Remainder and Requested Amount
content:
The requested amount of the final draw on a Reconstruction contract — the draw at substantial completion — is figured on this worksheet.

**1. Current contract sum.** The current contract sum is the contract amount plus the amount of every signed change order other than a deductive one, less the amount of every signed deductive change order, as the records stand on the request date.

**2. Earlier draws.** The earlier draws are every draw already requested on the contract; their requested amounts are after any retainage withheld, so each is counted before retainage, that is its requested amount divided by one less the tier's retainage percentage.

**3. Remainder.** The final draw's remainder is the current contract sum less the earlier draws counted before retainage, so that the earlier draws and the remainder together equal the current contract sum.

**4. Requested amount.** The final draw requests the current contract sum less the earlier draws counted before retainage, which is its remainder, less the final retainage, which on a tier with retainage is the tier's retainage percentage of that remainder, rounded to the cent, half up.

**5. Order of assembly.** The final draw's amount is put together in this order: first the remainder; then every amount the final draw also bills is added; then the final retainage and every amount held back are subtracted; a result below zero counts as zero; and only that result is rounded to the cent, half up.

The retainage percentage is the contract's own agreement figure on the draw schedule exhibit; on an agreement that withholds no retainage it is 0% and the earlier draws count at their requested amounts.

## Worked figures (hypothetical contract)

Inputs chosen for illustration: contract amount $80,000.00; signed additive change orders of $3,500.00 and $1,200.00; one signed deductive change order of $900.00; earlier draws requested totalling $57,340.00; an assumed retainage percentage of 6%.

| Line | Figure |
|---|---|
| Current contract sum: $80,000.00 plus $4,700.00 less $900.00 | $83,800.00 |
| Earlier draws counted before retainage: $57,340.00 divided by 0.94 | $61,000.00 |
| Remainder: $83,800.00 less $61,000.00 | $22,800.00 |
| Final retainage: 6% of $22,800.00 | $1,368.00 |
| Requested amount | $21,432.00 |

The same contract on an agreement that withholds no retainage, with earlier draws of $61,000.00: the remainder is $22,800.00 and the final retainage is nothing, so $22,800.00 is requested.
